en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates imported mpox case in 34-year-old man
en.dek: The man developed fever and a spreading rash earlier this week after high-risk sexual contact outside Hong Kong and is now in stable condition in isolation.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating an imported mpox case involving a 34-year-old man who is currently receiving isolation treatment at Queen Elizabeth Hospital and is in stable condition.

The patient developed a fever, fatigue and a rash on his arms on 9 November. The rash later spread to other parts of his body, including the genital area, abdomen and chest. He attended the Accident and Emergency Department of Queen Elizabeth Hospital on 11 November and was admitted for isolation. Laboratory testing of a clinical specimen confirmed the presence of the monkeypox virus.

According to the patient, he had high-risk sexual contact with other men outside Hong Kong during the incubation period. The centre is continuing its epidemiological investigation and will notify the World Health Organization of the case.

The Centre for Health Protection urged high-risk groups to receive the mpox vaccination and advised the public to remain vigilant and avoid close physical contact with anyone suspected of having the infection.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查34歲男子猴痘輸入個案
zh.dek: 病人本周較早時出現發燒及皮疹蔓延，潛伏期內離港期間與其他男子有高風險性接觸，現時隔離情況穩定。
body: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗猴痘輸入個案，涉及一名34歲男子，目前在伊利沙伯醫院接受隔離治療，情況穩定。
病人11月9日起出現發燒、疲倦及手臂皮疹，其後皮疹蔓延至身體多處，包括生殖器官、腹部及胸部。他11日到伊利沙伯醫院急症室求診並入院隔離。臨床樣本經化驗證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應。
根據病人提供的資料，他在潛伏期內離港期間曾與其他男子有高風險性接觸。中心正繼續進行流行病學調查，並會將個案通報世界衞生組織。
衞生防護中心呼籲高風險目標群組人士接種猴痘疫苗，並提醒市民提高警覺，避免與懷疑感染猴痘的人士作密切身體接觸。
